plot_concept_acceptance: User accepted the hook/synopsis with “заебись” on 2026-11-02. User accepted the complete storyboard and exact narration v02 plus on-screen accents v01 on 2026-11-02: “Да: narration v02 + акценты v01, один TTS-запрос в ElevenLabs”.
opening_hook: A frozen raindrop + “What do you do?”
ending_payoff: The drop falls; answer is “Nothing”—then five seconds older.
visual_reference: S01_v01 is accepted as a style reference. Old S02–S14 compositions are superseded by the user’s request to redo the images with varied angles.

scenes.narration_en_draft: Time stops. A raindrop hangs inches from your face. You have five seconds. What do you do?
scenes.image_plan: Extreme side macro: hero's eye left, suspended glasslike drop before nose in sharp focus, still street reflected in drop; leave clean space above/right.
scenes.caption_reason: Hook image and spoken question carry the beat; avoid duplicate question.

scenes.narration_en_draft: At first, it sounds like the perfect power.
scenes.image_plan: Elevated wide view across the street: frozen cyclist, hanging drops and buildings; hero is the only figure with an active pose, hand reaching toward the drop.
scenes.caption_reason: Image and narration already sell the tempting premise.

scenes.image_plan: High view down the street; windows, lamps, rain and cyclist fixed, hero small in frame. External explanatory diorama.
scenes.caption_reason: Hold back text so the next darkness reveal lands in order.

scenes.narration_en_draft: No light reaches your eyes. The world goes black.
scenes.image_plan: Extreme profile close-up of open eye against a matte black paper field; no reflected street. External explanatory composition, not literal POV.
scenes.caption_reason: Compress the visual mechanism without copying narration verbatim.

scenes.narration_en_draft: No sound reaches you, either. Sound needs vibrations moving through air.
scenes.image_plan: Close detail of cyclist bell in background and hero ear/hood in foreground; a short paper sound-wave arc stops before him.
scenes.caption_reason: Short visual cause/effect linked to the broken paper wave.

scenes.narration_en_draft: But the air has frozen too.
scenes.image_plan: Macro paper air model; irregular paper particles on hidden supports, wave arcs stop. No lattice, cage or crystal.
scenes.caption_reason: Let the newly revealed frozen air breathe before its consequences.

scenes.image_plan: Low pavement-level close-up: both cream shoes grounded, particles in front of toes, contact shadows visible; no step or displaced air.
scenes.caption_reason: Metaphorical shorthand for the invisible barrier.

scenes.narration_en_draft: You can’t draw it into your lungs.
scenes.image_plan: Side medium close-up head to chest; profile faces drop, particles remain outside nose; no anatomical cutaway or distress gesture.
scenes.caption_plan: THE TRAP IS ALL AROUND YOU
scenes.caption_reason: Broaden the breath problem without repeating the lung line.

scenes.narration_en_draft: You can’t even move the drop in front of your face.
scenes.image_plan: Return to opening macro composition and same nose-to-drop relation; hand hovers near without touching.
scenes.caption_reason: Summarize the drop’s consequence without repeating “can’t move”.

scenes.narration_en_draft: Like an insect caught in amber, you’re stuck.
scenes.image_plan: Top-down macro separate paper insect inside layered honey-amber paper volume on a base; hero is not encased.
scenes.caption_reason: Amber image already communicates the metaphor.

scenes.narration_en_draft: Five seconds of darkness, silence, and no way out.
scenes.image_plan: Very wide, nearly symmetrical view from street’s far end; small hero amid a dark still street, no glass walls or cage.
scenes.caption_reason: Frame the cost of the hook rather than restating the list.

scenes.narration_en_draft: Then time starts again. The drop falls.
scenes.image_plan: Low macro near wet curb; droplet meets paving, bicycle wheel shifted in background, warm reflections return. A single static instant, no animation.
scenes.caption_reason: The falling drop visually answers the opening.

scenes.narration_en_draft: So, what did you do with your five seconds? Nothing.
scenes.image_plan: New medium view, same world; hero lowers hand with bemused expression. Drop no longer hangs before him; cyclist stays in post-restart position.
scenes.caption_reason: Adds comic consequence after the spoken answer.

scenes.narration_en_draft: You just became five seconds older.
scenes.image_plan: Quiet close profile of same young hero, unchanged age/clothes, warm resumed street; clear space above for final accent.
scenes.caption_reason: Adds the closing irony after the spoken punchline.
